summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Pre-Paid Advance Agreement (PPA) with YA II PN, Ltd. (Yorkville). The company received a $15,958,000 pre-paid advance purchased at 94% of face value, yielding net proceeds of ~$15,000,520. Interest accrues at 4% annually subject to 18% upon default. Yorkville may convert outstanding balances into shares of Class A common stock at the lower of $0.2153 or 90% of the 5-day VWAP, with a $0.10 floor. This is a structured equity financing facility, not a traditional merger or tender. The arrangement exposes shareholders to dilution but lacks a fixed transaction price or premium. Watch for conversion notices and share price impact near the floor.
